reporting_rule: Only a frozen production-tier dataset with an independent review protocol may support production-representative claims; public_external_gold datasets may support explicitly named external benchmark claims.

datasets.purpose: Deterministic retrieval, citation, and abstention regression fixture.
datasets.claim_limit: Do not report as RAG quality or production retrieval accuracy.

datasets.purpose: Seeded single- and multi-intent routing integration checks.
datasets.claim_limit: Do not report as online intent-routing accuracy.

datasets.purpose: Seeded compound-intent detection, orchestration and safety-boundary regression fixture.
datasets.claim_limit: Do not report as online intent-routing accuracy.

datasets.purpose: Synthetic, bucketed intent-routing stress cases for aliases, typos, multi-stock ambiguity, backtest windows, clarification, high-risk trade wording and compound tasks.
datasets.claim_limit: Candidate diagnostics only; authored test wording is not real user traffic and must not support online or resume accuracy claims.

datasets.purpose: Scope validation and publication-gate safety regression fixture.
datasets.claim_limit: Do not report as real-world safety coverage.

datasets.purpose: Page-citable public-filing retrieval and abstention candidate set.
datasets.claim_limit: Candidate diagnostics only; do not report as production or resume quality.

datasets.purpose: Synthetic alias, stock-code, colloquial and filing-anchored retrieval stress set.
datasets.claim_limit: Synthetic candidate traffic; do not present as a real-user distribution or resume metric.

datasets.purpose: Template-generated alias and colloquial finance wording stress set for deterministic query rewrite diagnostics.
datasets.claim_limit: Synthetic candidate diagnostics only; it is not real-user traffic, independently human-reviewed evidence, a production metric, or a resume metric.

datasets.purpose: First frozen FinancialAgent E2E task/rubric contract covering research, clarification, compound planning, high-risk gates, citation, time semantics and recovery.
datasets.claim_limit: Candidate evaluator-contract fixture only; it does not measure real-user, production, model-quality or resume success.

datasets.purpose: 96-case FinancialAgent E2E reviewer queue with frozen task/tool/document fixtures and atomic rubrics across research, routing, safety and recovery categories.
datasets.claim_limit: Synthetic/public-source candidate review queue only; no item may be reported as real-user, independently reviewed, production or resume success until separate source and review admission complete.

datasets.purpose: Untouched three-filing held-out retrieval development set with 22 fact questions and 3 wrong-period abstentions.
datasets.claim_limit: Held-out documents do not make manual questions representative; use only for development diagnostics and never as a resume metric.

datasets.purpose: Independent two-filing held-out retrieval development set covering Guizhou Moutai and CATL.
datasets.claim_limit: Held-out documents do not make manual questions representative; use only for development diagnostics and never as a resume metric.

datasets.purpose: Real investor questions from the public CFQA dataset mapped to official annual-report pages for retrieval validation.
datasets.claim_limit: Candidate retrieval diagnostics only; public questions are not AlphaStock online logs and must not support production or resume quality claims.

datasets.purpose: Public FinanceBench open-source sample with human answers, justifications, evidence text, and PDF page labels.
datasets.claim_limit: May support external benchmark claims for this public dataset; it is not AlphaStock online traffic or production-representative quality.
